team.name: Dr. Anjali Patel, DDS
team.bio: Dr. Patel earned her Doctor of Dental Surgery degree from The Ohio State University in 2007 and founded Northline Dental Group in 2011. She has a special interest in restorative and cosmetic work, and sees patients at our Maple Ridge and Fairview offices.

team.name: Dr. Marcus Feld, DDS
team.bio: A vital part of our team since 2019, Dr. Marcus is a 2016 Case Western graduate who provides comprehensive general and family dentistry. He also leads most of our children’s dental work. If you or your little ones get a bit anxious about dental visits, you are in the best hands.

team.name: Denise Kowalczyk
team.bio: Denise has been with Northline since our first year and runs the front desk — scheduling, insurance questions, billing, and just about everything adjacent to it. If you’ve ever called one of our offices, there’s a good chance you’ve already talked to her

services.name: General dentistry
services.description: Complete exams, digital X-rays, oral cancer screenings, and honest treatment planning for the whole family.

services.name: Cleanings and hygiene
services.description: Gentle, thorough cleanings from our hygiene team, plus practical advice for keeping your smile healthy between visits.

services.name: Fillings
services.description: Tooth-colored composite fillings that blend in naturally and restore strength to decayed or damaged teeth.

services.name: Crowns and bridges
services.description: Durable, natural-looking crowns and bridges to repair broken teeth and replace missing ones.

services.name: Root canal treatment
services.description: Comfortable root canal therapy that relieves pain and saves your natural tooth.

services.name: Extractions
services.description: Gentle tooth extractions — including troublesome wisdom teeth — with clear aftercare instructions.

services.name: Teeth whitening
services.description: Professional whitening that brightens your smile several shades, safely and quickly.

services.name: Invisalign clear aligners
services.description: Straighten your teeth discreetly with clear, removable aligners. Ask us whether Invisalign is right for you.

services.name: Emergency appointments
services.description: Toothache, chipped tooth, or lost filling? Call us — we reserve time every business day for dental emergencies.

services.name: Children's dentistry
services.description: Friendly first visits and gentle care that helps kids grow up unafraid of the dentist.
